ISS-access.name: Login and account access failures
ISS-access.summary: Most reviews complain that users cannot log in, get logged out repeatedly, or cannot create or recover accounts.

ISS-billing.name: Free tier locked behind Premium
ISS-billing.summary: Most reviews complain that core features like playing specific songs, queuing, and playlists now require a Premium subscription, prompting cancellation threats.

ISS-catalog.name: Missing songs and lyrics
ISS-catalog.summary: Most reviews complain that certain songs, albums, or lyrics are unavailable, missing, or not displaying correctly.

ISS-downloads.name: Offline downloads not working
ISS-downloads.summary: Most reviews complain that downloaded music or podcasts will not play offline or that users cannot download content at all.

ISS-other.name: General dissatisfaction with updates
ISS-other.summary: Most reviews complain in broad, unspecific terms that recent updates have made the app worse and express general frustration.

ISS-playback.name: Playback stopping and crashing
ISS-playback.summary: Most reviews complain that music or podcasts stutter, cut out, pause unexpectedly, or the app crashes during playback.

ISS-support.name: Poor customer support responses
ISS-support.summary: Most reviews complain that customer support is slow, unhelpful, or hard to reach when problems occur.

ISS-usability.name: Intrusive ads and cluttered interface
ISS-usability.summary: Most reviews complain about frequent ads, especially for free users and Premium subscribers, along with a cluttered or confusing interface after updates.
